fusions.name: Volcanic Spatter
fusions.desc: Spits 3 gobbets of magma at once, each dealing 12 damage and bursting over every enemy within 3 tiles for 80% as much, with a 50% chance to set each one [Burning] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Clinker Shot
fusions.desc: Throws a clot of slag that deals 4 damage and sets the target [Burning] for 1 damage a second for 3 seconds. The slag hardens on it, with a 30% chance to leave the target [Slowed] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Magma Crust
fusions.desc: For 8 seconds a crust of cooling magma covers you: 40% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it, and sets them [Burning] for 2 damage a second for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Obsidian Haft
fusions.desc: Conjures a weapon of cooling magma and obsidian. It increases your weapon damage by 12%, and every strike with it sets the target [Burning] for 2 damage a second for 3 seconds.
